title: Write an Evaluative Thesis
author: Chee Skool
instruction: Write one or two sentences that identify the better-supported source and give two bounded reasons for that judgment. Do not argue which policy you personally prefer.
sourceFocus: Use both sources, but base the thesis on differences in evidence and reasoning rather than topic preference.
successCriteria: Gives two reasons that can be proved from the supplied sources.
Judges support and reasoning rather than personal agreement.
Avoids claims that are broader than the sources allow.
modelResponse: Source B is better supported because it uses building-specific engineering and cost evidence, and because its staged recommendation matches the uncertainty in the available data. Source A raises a relevant goal, but its citywide conclusion depends on assumptions that have not yet been tested across the buildings.
revisionPrompts: Can each reason in my thesis be supported with a specific detail from the sources?
Did I evaluate support rather than state which policy I personally like?
authoringNotes: Model deliberately uses a bounded two-reason thesis rather than a full introduction.
